title: Monomial after deleting a coordinate
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set of coordinates, let $i\in S$, and let $x$ be a sign assignment. The monomial on $S$ with coordinate $i$ deleted, multiplied by the sign at $i$, equals the monomial on $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
